title: Expressive Shallow Networks for Physics-Informed Learning: Why Curvature-Aware Optimization and FP64 Are Not Enough
abstract: arXiv:2611.28393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often struggle with high-frequency and high-order partial differential equations (PDEs) due to optimization stiffness and spectral bias, despite possessing sufficient approximation capacity. Existing remedies, including modified feature representations, domain decomposition, higher floating-point precision, and curvature-aware optimizers, can improve convergence but largely act as workarounds for optimization difficulties arising from deep architectures rather than addressing their underlying source. We investigate Physics-Informed Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks (PI-SUPNs), which replace deep nonlinear compositions with learnable polynomial expansions, retaining high approximation capacity within a shallow computational graph. On a high-frequency Helmholtz benchmark, PI-SUPNs are the only architecture to successfully recover the solution, while all competing models fail even under FP64 pr

translated_title: 面向物理信息学习的表达性浅层网络：为什么曲率感知优化与FP64精度仍不够
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在处理高频和高阶偏微分方程（PDE）时常常表现不佳，其原因在于优化刚性与频谱偏差，尽管这些网络本身具备足够的逼近能力。现有的补救措施，包括改进的特征表示、区域分解、更高浮点精度以及曲率感知优化器，虽然能够改善收敛性，但大多只是针对深层架构所引发优化困难的权宜之计，并未触及问题的根源。本文研究了物理信息浅层通用多项式网络（PI-SUPNs），该方法用可学习的多项式展开取代深层非线性复合结构，在浅层计算图中保持了较高的逼近能力。在高频Helmholtz方程基准测试中，PI-SUPNs是唯一能够成功恢复解的架构，而所有对比模型即使在FP64精度下也以失败告终。
tldr: 本文提出物理信息浅层通用多项式网络（PI-SUPNs），用可学习的多项式展开替代深层非线性复合，在高频Helmholtz基准中成为唯一成功求解的架构，证明了优化失败源于深层架构本身而非逼近能力不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Physics-Informed Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks (PI-SUPNs), which replace deep nonlinear compositions with learnable polynomial expansions and emerge as the only architecture to successfully solve a high-frequency Helmholtz benchmark, demonstrating that optimization failures stem from deep architectures themselves rather than insufficient approximation capacity.
